tracks.title: TRAVOLTI DA UN INSOLITO DESTINO NELL' AZZURRO MARE D'AGOSTO

reading.notes: Photo collage of a recording studio (microphone, 'STUDIO A IN REGISTRAZIONE' sign, man in blue shirt) above small-print credit columns. Only song titles with musician credits are listed; no track numbers, positions or durations are printed. The text is very small and mostly illegible, so titles are uncertain. Some credits mention 'Music & Lyrics', 'From the Movie Travolti da un insolito destino... (1974)', and 'Lyrics: Giorgio Calabrese' / 'Umberto Bindi'. A thank-you text at right mentions EdelweissMUSIC.
